en.title: Inactive Contracts
en.summary: Contracts that have lapsed, including the ones the system expired by itself.

sections.heading: How a contract gets here
sections.body:
On its end date, the system marks a contract inactive by itself and records the reason "Automatic Expiration of Contract By System". Nothing is deleted: the payments, the requests and the whole history stay exactly as they were.

A contract can also be made inactive deliberately, with its own reason on the record.

sections.heading: What to do with the list
sections.body:
• Read it as the list of business you have stopped billing for. A site that lapsed quietly is revenue that stopped without anybody deciding it should.
• Open a contract to see its terms, its file and its payment history.
• If the customer is staying, renew rather than writing a fresh contract — the renewal keeps the history and the renewal count together.

sections.heading: Prevention
sections.body: The dashboard puts every contract within 30 days of its end date in a red panel. Working that panel each week is what keeps this list short.

am.title: ንቁ ያልሆኑ ኮንትራቶች
am.summary: ያለፉ ኮንትራቶች፤ ሲስተሙ ራሱ ያበቃቸውንም ጨምሮ።

sections.heading: ኮንትራት እንዴት ወደዚህ ይመጣል
sections.body:
በመጨረሻ ቀኑ ሲስተሙ ራሱ ኮንትራቱን ንቁ ያልሆነ አድርጎ ምክንያቱን ይመዘግባል። ምንም አይሰረዝም፦ ክፍያዎቹ፣ ጥያቄዎቹና ታሪኩ በሙሉ እንዳሉ ይቀራሉ።

ኮንትራት ሆን ተብሎም ንቁ ያልሆነ ሊደረግ ይችላል፤ ምክንያቱም በመዝገቡ ላይ ይቀመጣል።

sections.heading: በዝርዝሩ ምን ማድረግ
sections.body:
• ክፍያ ማቅረብ ያቆሙበት ሥራ ዝርዝር አድርገው ያንብቡት። በዝምታ ያለፈ ጣቢያ ማንም ሳይወስን የቆመ ገቢ ነው።
• ውሎቹን፣ ፋይሉንና የክፍያ ታሪኩን ለማየት ኮንትራቱን ይክፈቱ።
• ደንበኛው የሚቀጥል ከሆነ አዲስ ኮንትራት ከመጻፍ ይልቅ ያድሱ — ዕድሳት ታሪኩንና የዕድሳት ቁጥሩን አብረው ይይዛል።

sections.heading: መከላከያ
sections.body: ዳሽቦርዱ የመጨረሻ ቀናቸው በ30 ቀናት ውስጥ የሆኑ ኮንትራቶችን በሙሉ በቀይ ክፍል ውስጥ ያሳያል። ይህን ክፍል በየሳምንቱ መሥራት ነው ይህን ዝርዝር አጭር የሚያደርገው።
